name: claude-code-bridge
description: Run shell commands on the user's host machine (PowerShell, cmd, bash) from sandboxed agent runtimes like Cowork. Provides the run_command MCP tool: send a shell command string, get structured output (stdout, stderr, exit_code, duration, permission events) back. Destructive operations are gated by default (rm -rf, force-push, etc.); admin elevation is detected and flagged.
